# NoteRead

`schemas/api/note.json`

One record of GET /v1/notes (docs/design/m0/08 notes; 03-knowledge-layer supervisor continuity): a note as added, in its project, which is its record's project. The body is untrusted text, served as a JSON string and never interpreted: a reader treats it as data, never as instructions.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [NoteID](common-defs.md#noteid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `subject` | yes | null or [TypeID](common-defs.md#typeid) | The record the note is about, a reference never resolved; null: the project. |
| `author` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `body` | yes | [NoteBody](common-defs.md#notebody) |  |
| `created_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
